profile.headline: AI/ML Engineer || @ General Motors/Cruise | Master’s in Computer Science
profile.summary:
Software Engineer | General Motors - Software Defined Vehicle
Passionate software engineer with over 3 years of experience developing in-house tools for data ingestion and analysis, leveraging modern cloud computing methodologies. I hold undergraduate and graduate degrees in Computer Science with a focus on Distributed Systems, Cloud Computing, and Machine Learning from Florida International University and the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

My areas of expertise include Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS), Software Design, Distributed Systems, API Development and Optimization, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Big Data Analytics (Storm, MapReduce).

Driven by a deep enthusiasm for software development and continuous learning, I thrive on tackling new challenges that foster growth and lead to impactful solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the development of an automation framework to analyze in-vehicle data, saving the Test Engineers over 100 days of manual verification
Contributed to developing automation analysis scripts 2x as fast
Lead defect resolution efforts which led to over 40 of them being resolved to date
Refactored over 50% of the existing automation scripts, improving maintainability, readability and efficiency
Contributed to the development of an internal tool to analyze, collect and organize data used in the development of Autonomous Vehicle Software using Azure Functions, reducing requirements development time by over 50%
Enhanced efficiency and scalability of the application by writing clean code and correcting over 120 defects
Developed parsers for Excel Templates allowing for the collection of data in a structured way increasing efficiency and reducing errors
Created reusable components with ReactJS improving scalability, reusability and user experience
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · HTML · Data Analysis · Java · React.js · API Development · Back-End Web Development · Software Development · Front-End Development · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Functions · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: STARS Program Tutor
positions.description:
Assist students with their coursework through online communication.  
Subjects include: C and Java programming, Data Structures, Computer Architecture and Database Management.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description: Worked as a STEM Learning Assistant supporting faculty and students through the academic year. Mainly focused in Math, Programming and Natural Science.

positions.title: Biology Department Intern
positions.description:
Working under supervision of Dr. Robert Smith.
Modeling the ability of bacteria to cooperate under a set of parameters using the NetLogo software. 
Results were presented in poster format at the Miami Dade College Science Symposium.
